topic.label: Claude Duet
topic.desc: Claude Duet, Anthropic's always-on Claude for one person: a main chat, task threads for longer work, channels for lasting subjects, a Tasks page, a morning brief and check-ins, routines and reminders, memory of goals and rules, and connected apps, with the person's approval before anything is sent, paid, signed or deleted.

concepts: The one ongoing conversation the person texts or talks to: a short answer first, or a line that longer work has started on a task.
Longer work on one task runs in its own thread, with a live status checklist and a report when the work stops for the person or finishes.
A separate chat for one lasting subject, such as a project or a move, with its own tasks, files and notes.
Where every task stands: working, ready for the person, stopped, or resolved, with its steps, its question and its outcome.
A short brief when quiet hours end, and check-ins through the day when something in the connected apps needs the person.
Work that runs on a schedule: routines that repeat, one-time reminders, and watches that look at set times.
What Claude keeps about the person between sessions: goals, rules in their own words, preferences and open loops, which they can ask to see, correct or forget.
Mail, calendar, chat and file connectors and a browser for websites, with drafts the person approves before anything is sent, paid, signed or deleted, and pages or docs as results.
skills: Send a request by text or voice in the main chat and get the answer, or one line saying the work has started and on which task.
Send a follow-up about work already started, such as a change of scope or a new detail, so it reaches that task without starting a new one.
Answer a yes or no question with a reaction
Use a thumbs-up or thumbs-down on a yes or no question as the answer; a step that spends money or deletes for good still needs a yes in words.
Open the thread of a task to see its status checklist grow step by step while the work runs.
Read the report a task leaves when it stops: the answer or what is needed, what was done in the person's name, what could not be checked, and the one thing to tap or answer.
Write to a task in its thread
Write in a task's own thread to answer its question, add a detail or redirect it, and get a reply there.
Start a channel for a project
Ask for a channel for one task or project so its conversation, tasks and notes stay apart from the main chat.
Keep a project's files in its channel
Keep the files for a subject in its channel's folder, where every task in that channel can read them.
Review a task that is ready for you
Open a task marked ready for you, look at the draft, result or question, and answer or act on it.
Read why a task stopped, such as an app to connect or a reply from someone else, and give what it waits on.
Mark a finished task done, or say it is not done yet so the work goes on.
Read the brief that arrives when quiet hours end: what needs the person today, from mail, calendar and open tasks.
Set quiet hours and the time zone
Choose the hours when no brief or check-in arrives, and the time zone that times are read in.
Turn the brief and check-ins off or on
Switch the morning brief and check-ins off when unasked messages are not wanted, and back on later.
Ask for a reminder at a set time; it arrives once as a message in the chat.
Ask for work that repeats on a schedule, such as a weekly preview, and say what each run should look at and post.
Watch for something at set times
Ask Claude to look for a change, such as a reply or a price, at set times, and be told when it happens.
Say a rule in your own words, such as never booking before 10, and Claude says it back and works by it from then on.
Ask what Claude knows about you and your work, and get it in plain words.
Correct a wrong note or ask Claude to forget something, and it is changed or removed and not brought back.
Connect mail, calendar, chat, files or a work tool so Claude can read them and draft for you.
Approve a draft before it is sent
Look at a drafted message with every recipient, edit it if needed, and press Send; nothing in your name goes out, gets paid or gets deleted without your yes.
Get a page or a doc as the result
Ask for a document, plan or report and get it as a doc or page you can open, edit and share.
